### Review by [@copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]](https://github.com/apps/copilot-pull-request-reviewer) (commented) — 2026-06-12T15:11:49Z

## Pull request overview

> [!NOTE]
> Copilot was unable to run its full agentic suite in this review.

Updates the DRA setup documentation to clarify how to set counter-based quotas in ClusterQueues and warns about unit-scale consistency when sharing cohorts.

**Changes:**
- Expands the counter quota guidance from a single sentence into a short explanatory paragraph.
- Adds an explicit warning that Kueue does not validate unit consistency across ClusterQueues in a cohort.

- **site/content/en/docs/tasks/manage/setup_dra.md:239** by [@Copilot](https://github.com/apps/copilot-pull-request-reviewer) — 2026-06-12T15:11:49Z
```diff
@@ -234,7 +234,9 @@ gpu.example.com  gpu-0: [{"counterSet":"shared","counters":{"memory":{"value":"1
 
 ### 2. Add the counter resource to your ClusterQueue
 
-Set the quota in counter units instead of device count:
+Set the quota in counter units instead of device count. When ClusterQueues
+share a cohort, ensure all queues use the same unit scale for counter
+resources. Kueue does not validate unit consistency across ClusterQueues.
```

  The new warning is helpful but incomplete without a concrete example of what “same unit scale” means (e.g., Mi vs Gi, or 1e6 vs 1e9) and what the user-visible failure mode would look like (mis-accounting, unexpected admission/borrowing behavior). Consider adding a brief example or a short sentence specifying which units/scales are expected for the referenced counter (matching the advertised counter units from the resource driver / ResourceClass) and what happens if they differ.
